items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Willie Piazza, she had a place back there where the project is now.

ctx.x: So what went on in the district after you were in the city, it was supposed to be closed about the time of the First World War.

It was. But it, it, it, it, what happened after that? It was, it was open back there for years after that, but it wasn't as open, you know, as it, as it was written in. It, it, it, it, other words it was, it was on a, it had a few places back there. They had a place called The Entertainers. And then a fella by the name of Lala had a place back there. And Tom Anderson had the Arlington back there. Well there was, there was three or four places. That had music back there. That had music back there. For, for, oh, I…
